title: Tech Note: Converting Databases to 4D V6

historical_commentary.text: This note guides developers through converting 3.x databases to V6, including the terminology shift the V6 release introduced (e.g. Phases becoming Events, Procedures becoming Methods); as a one-time historical migration guide for a conversion path that closed decades ago, it is now of purely historical interest.
related_updates: 4D V6 introduced Events (replacing Phases) and Methods (replacing Procedures) terminology, referenced here as a source of conversion confusion
The binary .4DB/.4DC structure file format used by V3/V6-era databases has long since been superseded by the modern structure file format, and further by Project Mode (introduced v17, 2018)
